## Mechanism

Live memo events use a **pub/sub SSE hub** on `APIV1Service`:

1. **Hub creation** — `NewAPIV1Service` creates `SSEHub` and stores it on the service (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`).
2. **Client subscription** — `RegisterSSERoutes` exposes `GET /api/v1/sse`; `handleSSE` authenticates, calls `hub.Subscribe(userID, role)`, and streams JSON events from the client channel (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`).
3. **Broadcasting** — handlers call `s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{...})` (directly or via helpers). `Broadcast` marshals the event, iterates subscribed clients, filters by visibility via `SSEClient.canReceive`, and drops events for slow clients with full buffers (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`).
4. **Suppression** — `CreateMemo` skips broadcast when `isSSESuppressed(ctx)` is true (used by `CreateMemoComment` to avoid duplicate `memo.created`) (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`).

**Event types** (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`):

| Type | Constant |
|------|----------|
| `memo.created` | `SSEEventMemoCreated` |
| `memo.updated` | `SSEEventMemoUpdated` |
| `memo.deleted` | `SSEEventMemoDeleted` |
| `memo.comment.created` | `SSEEventMemoCommentCreated` |
| `reaction.upserted` | `SSEEventReactionUpserted` |
| `reaction.deleted` | `SSEEventReactionDeleted` |

---

## Hub implementation files

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` | `SSEHub`, `SSEEvent`, `SSEClient`, `Broadcast`, `Subscribe`/`Unsubscribe`/`Close`, visibility filtering |
| `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` | SSE HTTP endpoint (`RegisterSSERoutes`, `handleSSE`) |
| `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go` | `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent`, `resolveSSECreatorID`, `buildMemoName` |
| `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (broadcasts `memo.updated`) |

---

|--------|------|-------|
| `CreateMemo` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.created` (lines 161–168; skipped when `isSSESuppressed`) |
| `DeleteMemo` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.deleted` (lines 584–590) |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` | `memo.comment.created` (lines 125–131) |

### Via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `SSEHub.Broadcast` (`memo.updated`)

|--------|------|-----------|
| `UpdateMemo` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | line 513 |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` | line 48 |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` | line 48 |

Helper definition: `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` lines 66–78.

### Via `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent` → `SSEHub.Broadcast` (reaction events on memos)
